description.text: The ninth Sun & Moon set, released on 1 February 2019 with 196 cards: 181 and 15 secret rares. It brought in TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX, six of them, among them Pikachu & Zekrom-GX: cards that pair two Pokémon, more powerful than other Pokémon-GX, with effects that grow when extra Energy is attached. Tied to Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!, it has many Kanto Pokémon, beside six more Pokémon-GX and four Prism Star cards.
